steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow described by the case.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Provide the required event title so the event can be published.
Apply the first available RFQ template to render the product sheet.
Add one CYLINDER line item with the requested quantity.
Complete remaining required pricing-sheet fields before publishing.
Commit a valid event schedule required for publishing.
Invite one QA test vendor so the event has a participant to search.
Publish the event so its participant list can be inspected after publication.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Open the published event's participant list.
Search for the invited plan vendor in the participant list; omitting the name uses the vendor selected for this plan.
Assert that the participant search leaves exactly one matching vendor listed.
